sections.skill: Mailing a pillow versus a book

questions.prompt: Why can the pillow box cost a lot?

choices.text: It is big even though it is light
Pillows are illegal to mail in boxes

questions.correct_answer: It is big even though it is light
questions.intro: A pillow is light but big; a book is small but heavy. Carriers care about both, so a big pillow box can cost more than you expect. Choosing the smallest box that protects the item can lower cost. And the return address is like the "return to sender" note: it should go somewhere you reliably check.
